title: feat(hugdbl): corridor-slide doubled pairing holds k=1..4
science: Doubled pairing ((2k,0,0),(k,k,k)) under mu on B_12 at every available k=1..4: 3t_axis^2 vs 4t_body^2 = 108>100, 432>256, 768>484, 972>784, all reverse.
